title: Implement comprehensive SEO optimization for multi-service professional website

requirements.text: Add comprehensive meta tags to index.html including title optimized for 'Legal Consultant | Business Consultant | Digital Marketing | Graphic Design | Video Editing | Web Development', meta description highlighting all six service areas, and relevant keywords for national/international searches

quotes: Legal,Business consaltent,Digital marketer, Graphic Designer, Video Editor, Website Designer, and Developer

acceptanceCriteria: Title tag includes all six service areas in a natural, readable format
Meta description is compelling and includes all services within 155-160 characters
Keywords meta tag includes relevant terms for each service area
Meta tags are properly formatted and validated

requirements.text: Implement JSON-LD structured data for Professional Service schema covering legal consulting, business consulting, digital marketing, graphic design, video editing, and web development services with proper schema.org markup
acceptanceCriteria: JSON-LD script includes ProfessionalService schema for each of the six service areas
Schema includes service name, description, provider information, and service type
Structured data validates successfully in Google's Rich Results Test
Schema is embedded in the document head or appropriate component

requirements.text: Add Blog Post schema (Article/BlogPosting) to all five existing blog article pages (digital marketing, graphic design, law/legal, video editing, web design/dev) with proper headline, author, datePublished, and image properties

quotes: Blog post schema for better content visibility

acceptanceCriteria: Each blog article page includes BlogPosting or Article schema
Schema includes headline, author, datePublished, dateModified, and image properties
Article schema validates in Google's Rich Results Test
Schema is dynamically generated based on article data from blogArticles.ts

requirements.text: Enhance Open Graph tags in index.html with og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, og:type optimized for social media sharing of the multi-service professional portfolio

quotes: Open Graph tags for social media sharing

acceptanceCriteria: og:title accurately represents the multi-service professional brand
og:description includes all six service areas
og:image points to a professional preview image
og:type is set to 'website'
Tags render correctly in Facebook and LinkedIn preview tools

requirements.text: Generate an XML sitemap that includes all main pages (home, about, services, skills, portfolio, contact, blog landing) and all five blog article pages with proper priority and changefreq values

quotes: Sitemap generation for search engine crawling

acceptanceCriteria: XML sitemap includes all navigable routes from App.tsx
Sitemap includes proper lastmod, changefreq, and priority values
Sitemap is accessible at /sitemap.xml
Sitemap validates against XML sitemap schema

requirements.text: Add robots.txt file to frontend/public allowing all crawlers and referencing the sitemap location

quotes: Sitemap generation for search engine crawling

acceptanceCriteria: robots.txt file exists in frontend/public
File includes 'User-agent: *' and 'Allow: /'
File includes sitemap reference
File is accessible at /robots.txt

requirements.text: Enhance semantic HTML structure across all pages ensuring proper heading hierarchy (h1, h2, h3), meaningful alt text for all images, and ARIA labels where appropriate for accessibility and SEO

quotes: Semantic HTML with proper heading hierarchy
Semantic HTML with proper headings and keywords

acceptanceCriteria: Each page has exactly one h1 tag with primary keyword
Heading hierarchy follows proper nesting (h1 > h2 > h3)
All images include descriptive alt text relevant to service areas
Interactive elements have appropriate ARIA labels
HTML validates without accessibility warnings

requirements.text: Optimize page performance by implementing lazy loading for images, code splitting for routes, and ensuring Core Web Vitals metrics (LCP, FID, CLS) meet Google's recommended thresholds
acceptanceCriteria: Images use loading='lazy' attribute where appropriate
Routes are code-split using React lazy/Suspense
LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) is under 2.5 seconds
CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) is under 0.1
Lighthouse performance score is 90 or above

requirements.text: Update SEO utility (lib/seo.ts) to support dynamic meta descriptions and keywords for each page, ensuring services pages and blog articles have unique, keyword-optimized metadata

quotes: Meta tags optimized for all your service areas

acceptanceCriteria: SEO utility accepts and sets meta description parameter
SEO utility accepts and sets meta keywords parameter
Each major page (Services, Portfolio, Skills) has unique meta description
Blog articles use their article description for meta tags
Meta descriptions are compelling and include relevant service keywords

requirements.text: Add canonical URL tags to all pages to prevent duplicate content issues and ensure proper indexing by search engines
acceptanceCriteria: Each page includes a canonical link tag in the head
Canonical URLs use absolute paths including domain
Canonical URLs are consistent with the actual page URL
Blog article pages include proper canonical tags

constraints: Do not modify immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Maintain the existing single-actor Motoko backend architecture in backend/main.mo
Preserve the static waterfall background and dark header navigation styling
Keep all existing blog articles and their content intact
Maintain the existing project portfolio structure with 60 projects
nonGoals: Implementing paid advertising campaigns or Google Ads integration
Setting up Google Search Console or Analytics (can be done separately)
Creating new blog content or modifying existing blog article text
Implementing backend SEO tracking or analytics
Adding third-party SEO tools or plugins
Implementing real-time SEO monitoring or reporting features
Changing the visual design or layout of existing pages
